text:
Maria: Morning — quick async standup. Yesterday: demo w/ NovaHealth, sent security pack. Today: follow-up with legal for NDA, need ETA from eng on HSM KMS integration for Dedicated pilot. Blockers: security asked for HSM keywrap flow diagram and SSO SAML metadata. @Olivia can you grab SAML metadata? @Lee do we have a perf number for 3k qps per region? :thinking:
Olivia: On it — will upload SAML metadata to the deal drive by EOD. Also looped security for the keywrap diagram, they said 'need sequence diagram + KMS policy excerpts'.
Lee: perf numbers — 3k qps steady-state requires 4x p4d-like nodes with current batching; with quantization we can drop to 3 nodes. Can get exact latency p50/p95 by EOD. @Samir can you confirm infra plan?
Samir: Confirmed infra plan for Dedicated pilot. Will provision staging cluster tomorrow AM. For HSM we need customer to confirm supported algorithms (RSA vs ECDSA) and whether they need importable keys. Pinged the contact at NovaHealth.
Maria: Security asked whether we support key rotation logs for audit. If not, need timeline. @SecurityBot any automated evidence artifacts we can attach?
SecurityBot: Automated note: We can provide KMS rotation logs and HSM audit events as part of Private package. Attachments accepted: `kms_rotation_export.csv`, `hsm_event_stream.log` (sample). Need Eng enable logging endpoint.
Olivia: Uploading SAML metadata now: link: https://redwood-internal/drive/NovaHealth/saml-metadata.xml
Lee: For performance — p50 90ms, p95 260ms on 3 node quantized setup for 1k seq len. I'll post perf csv after validation.
Samir: For HSM integration plan — two options: 1) Proxy keywrap on our side (faster but customer keys not importable), 2) Bring-your-own-HSM (longer onboarding). Recommend option 2 for enterprise; need legal on contract clause. @Maria can you flag?
Maria: Flagged. Also ask: are we ok to give a short code snippet to customer showing `curl` to hit a non-production endpoint? They want dev access. Example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"r-instruct-1","input":"test"}'
```
Lee: Fine to give staging creds via SSO link, just don't share prod tokens.
Priya: Quick note — demo recording uploaded, and legal asked for redacted logs to prove data isolation. @Samir can you schedule a log extraction? :calendar:
Samir: Yep, scheduling log grab for staging cluster at 16:00 PT. Will deliver redacted bundle.
Maria: Great. Last ask: can we get a brief one-page security summary for the deal (SOC2 controls + KMS/HSM notes) by tomorrow noon? @Olivia / @Priya take lead?
Olivia: I can draft. Priya — can you add SOC2 control mapping?
Priya: Yup, will add sections on access control and audit.
Maria: Awesome, thanks team. If anything urgent ping me, otherwise next async check-in tomorrow. :rocket:
